question: What attainment makes a practitioner dear to the yoginīs?
premises: Enjoyment, liberation, and great accomplishment form a supreme attainment.
This attainment relates to the yoginīs.
Such attainment can make one dear to them.
inference: One who gains the great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation becomes dear to the yoginīs.
plain_english: Through the great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation, one may become dear to the yoginīs.
